confidence_model.rule: Technique observed by BOTH static and dynamic evidence -> High, unless both sources' best individual confidence is Low -> Medium. Technique observed by a single source retains that source's own best per-finding confidence tier unchanged (cannot be promoted by a single source alone).

evidence.name: System Network Configuration Discovery
evidence.justification: The managed .NET API calls System.Net.NetworkInformation.NetworkInterface::GetAllNetworkInterfaces, System.Net.NetworkInformation.NetworkInterface::GetIPProperties were resolved from the assembly's method bodies (call/callvirt/newobj targets, not just type/method names). Multiple corroborating BCL API calls, not one in isolation, is what makes this a strong signal for System Network Configuration Discovery.

evidence.name: Data Staged
evidence.justification: The malware strings GZipStream, FilenameInZip, ZipFileEntry indicate an archive-building engine bundling data prior to transfer. The same evidence that supports Archive via Utility (T1560.001) also supports Data Staged (T1074) -- collecting data into an archive format is a form of staging it before exfiltration.
